name: Catherine W. Smith
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Seattle, Washington
education: University of Washington School of Law
about: Catherine's practice is limited to civil appeals in Washington state and federal courts. Her broad appellate experience is reflected in hundreds of decisions, including Beauregard v. WSBA , 197 Wn.2d 67 (2021), in which she represented the State Bar, and Mohandessi v. Urban Venture, LLC , 13 Wn. App.2d 681 (2020). Catherine is editor-in-chief of the Washington Appellate Practice Deskbook , served as President of the American Academy of Appellate Lawyers, and founded the Washington Appellate Lawyers Association. Of her appearance before the U.S. Supreme Court in Troxel v. Granville , Dahlia Lithwick of Slate magazine reported, "she is one of the finest oral advocates I have ever seen."
honors: WSBA Family Lawyer of the Year , 2001
